verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog states directly that during a coding session, Linear Agent detects and installs the toolchains and dependencies it needs to complete the task. It also sets up, runs and tests code in cloud sessions, and teams can pin runtime versions, add setup scripts and define environment variables. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which toolchains/languages are auto-detected and how detection works, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond brief changelog entries.
